meta.name: rescue-pilot-1
meta.selection: top-3 failed idioms per language from the 2026-08-05 morning iPad session (287 reviews), ranked by Agains today then 14-day Agains

formats.video: one per language, MiniMax-H3 6s 768P — concrete visual-metaphor scene tied to the failed sentence
formats.comic: one per language, Nano Banana 3-panel strip — narrative/humor encoding
formats.svg: one per language, hand-authored diagram — structural/morphological encoding
formats.baseline: every expression: anchor line (mnemonic hook), 3 personalized sentences (user's world: tech criticism, media, geopolitics) with EN gloss + ElevenLabs audio (same voices as main decks), 2 exercises (cloze + EN→TL production)

expressions.failed_sentence: Una vez que la negociación se desbloquee, firmaremos el contrato.
expressions.anchor: des·BLOQUE·e — picture a concrete BLOCK (bloque) crumbling. The final -e is the subjunctive flag: after «una vez que / hasta que / cuando» pointing at the FUTURE, the unblocking hasn't happened yet — so it takes -e, not -a.

sentences.tl: Cuando el acuerdo sobre los chips se desbloquee, las dos potencias volverán a fingir que se llevan bien.
sentences.en: When the chip agreement gets unblocked, the two powers will go back to pretending they get along.

sentences.tl: No publiques la investigación hasta que se desbloquee el embargo de prensa.
sentences.en: Don't publish the investigation until the press embargo is lifted.

sentences.tl: Dudo que el debate sobre la regulación de las plataformas se desbloquee antes de las elecciones.
sentences.en: I doubt the platform-regulation debate will get unstuck before the elections.

exercises.prompt: Una vez que la negociación ______ (desbloquearse), firmaremos el contrato.
Once the funding gets unstuck, we'll relaunch the project.
exercises.answer: Una vez que la financiación se desbloquee, relanzaremos el proyecto.
exercises.trap: Not «se desbloquea» — the event is still pending, so subjunctive.

expressions.failed_sentence: Tu abrigo está tirado en el suelo.
expressions.anchor: From tirar (to throw): thrown down and LEFT there. Watch the polysemy: «¡está tirado!» can also mean “it's dirt cheap” or “it's a piece of cake” — context decides; with places (en el suelo, en un cajón) it means lying abandoned.

sentences.tl: El informe del regulador está tirado en un cajón desde marzo.
sentences.en: The regulator's report has been lying in a drawer since March.

sentences.tl: Su viejo smartphone está tirado en el fondo de un armario, lleno de datos personales.
sentences.en: His old smartphone is lying at the bottom of a closet, full of personal data.

sentences.tl: Después de la mudanza, la mitad de mis libros sigue tirada por el suelo.
sentences.en: After the move, half of my books are still lying around on the floor.

exercises.prompt: Tu abrigo ______ ______ en el suelo. (two words: to be + thrown down)
exercises.why: estar + participle of tirar — a state resulting from being thrown

exercises.prompt: The documents are lying on the table, and nobody reads them.
exercises.answer: Los documentos están tirados en la mesa y nadie los lee.

expressions.anchor: «dar por X» = to FILE it under X. You hand (dar) the thing over to the category “finished”. The participle agrees with the noun: la relación → terminadA, el debate → terminadO.

sentences.tl: El moderador dio por terminada la entrevista cuando empezaron los insultos.
sentences.en: The moderator declared the interview over when the insults started.

sentences.tl: La comisión dio por terminada la investigación sin publicar sus conclusiones.
sentences.en: The commission considered the investigation closed without publishing its findings.

sentences.tl: Doy por terminada esta discusión en los comentarios.
sentences.en: I'm declaring this comment-section argument over.

exercises.why: dar por + participle, feminine agreement with «la relación»

exercises.prompt: The referee declared the match over.
exercises.answer: El árbitro dio por terminado el partido.

expressions.gloss: was in the loop / in the know
expressions.failed_sentence: Eles não estavam por dentro do que acontecia.
expressions.fails: 2 Agains today, 9 in 14 days — worst PT repeat offender
expressions.anchor: por DENTRO = on the INSIDE — inside the glass room where the real conversation happens. Opposite: «estar por fora» = out of the loop. estar por dentro DE algo.

sentences.tl: Poucos jornalistas estavam por dentro das negociações entre o governo e as plataformas.
sentences.en: Few journalists were in the loop on the negotiations between the government and the platforms.

sentences.tl: Ele sempre está por dentro das últimas polêmicas do Vale do Silício.
sentences.en: He's always up to speed on the latest Silicon Valley controversies.

sentences.tl: Quem não estava por dentro do acordo ficou sabendo pela imprensa.
sentences.en: Whoever wasn't in the know about the deal found out from the press.

exercises.prompt: Eles não estavam ______ ______ do que acontecia. (in the loop)
exercises.why: estar por dentro de = to be informed about

exercises.prompt: Are you up to speed on the new privacy rules?
exercises.answer: Você está por dentro das novas regras de privacidade?

expressions.gloss: there's no such thing as / none of that … here
expressions.failed_sentence: Com ela, não tem esse negócio de meio-termo.
expressions.anchor: negócio = literally “business”, colloquially “thing/stuff”. «Não tem esse negócio de X» = “there's no this-business-of X around here” — a door slammed on a whole category. Grandma energy.

sentences.tl: Na redação dela, não tem esse negócio de matéria patrocinada.
sentences.en: In her newsroom, there's no such thing as sponsored content.

sentences.tl: Não tem esse negócio de algoritmo neutro — alguém sempre escolhe os critérios.
sentences.en: There's no such thing as a neutral algorithm — someone always picks the criteria.

sentences.tl: Aqui em casa não tem esse negócio de celular na mesa do jantar.
sentences.en: In this house there's none of that phone-at-the-dinner-table business.

exercises.prompt: Com ela, não tem esse ______ de meio-termo. (thing/business)
exercises.why: fixed colloquial chunk: não tem esse negócio de + noun

exercises.prompt: With my boss, there's no such thing as a short meeting.
exercises.answer: Com o meu chefe, não tem esse negócio de reunião curta.
exercises.trap: Keep it singular and bare: «de reunião curta», no article.

expressions.gloss: after all / at the end of the day
expressions.failed_sentence: Você não deveria ser tão duro com ele; afinal de contas, ele é só uma criança.
expressions.anchor: Literally “at the END of the ACCOUNTS”: when the ledger is tallied, this is what remains. Use it to play the trump card of an argument.

sentences.tl: Afinal de contas, quem lucra com a atenção dos usuários?
sentences.en: At the end of the day, who profits from users' attention?

sentences.tl: Não seja tão duro com o estagiário; afinal de contas, é o primeiro emprego dele.
sentences.en: Don't be so hard on the intern; after all, it's his first job.

sentences.tl: Afinal de contas, o debate sobre IA é um debate sobre poder.
sentences.en: After all, the debate about AI is a debate about power.

exercises.prompt: ______ de ______, ele é só uma criança. (after all)
exercises.why: fixed discourse marker: afinal de contas

exercises.prompt: After all, nobody reads the terms of service.
exercises.answer: Afinal de contas, ninguém lê os termos de uso.
exercises.trap: Don't translate word-by-word from «after all» — the chunk is afinal de contas.

expressions.gloss: shadow zones / blind spots (lit. cones of shadow)
expressions.failed_sentence: La nuova legge sulla privacy lascia alcuni coni d'ombra che vanno chiariti.
expressions.anchor: A flashlight throws a CONE of light — everything behind an obstacle sits in a cono d'ombra. Journalistic staple: laws, inquiries and algorithms all “lasciano coni d'ombra”.

sentences.tl: L'inchiesta ha chiarito molto, ma restano alcuni coni d'ombra sul finanziamento.
sentences.en: The investigation clarified a lot, but some gray areas remain around the funding.

sentences.tl: Ogni algoritmo di raccomandazione ha i suoi coni d'ombra, invisibili perfino a chi lo progetta.
sentences.en: Every recommendation algorithm has its blind spots, invisible even to its designers.

sentences.tl: La nuova legge sull'IA lascia coni d'ombra che le piattaforme sapranno sfruttare.
sentences.en: The new AI law leaves gray areas that the platforms will know how to exploit.

exercises.prompt: La legge lascia alcuni ______ d'______ che vanno chiariti. (blind spots)
exercises.why: fixed metaphor: coni d'ombra, plural of cono d'ombra

exercises.prompt: The report leaves some gray areas about the contracts.
exercises.answer: Il rapporto lascia alcuni coni d'ombra sui contratti.
exercises.trap: Collocates with lasciare/restare; preposition su for the topic.

expressions.gloss: to go hand in hand / belong together
expressions.failed_sentence: La teoria e la pratica devono andare insieme per ottenere buoni risultati.
expressions.anchor: Two gears meshing: X e Y VANNO INSIEME — they turn together or not at all. Plural verb: due cose vanno insieme.

sentences.tl: Innovazione e regolamentazione devono andare insieme, altrimenti vince il più furbo.
sentences.en: Innovation and regulation must go hand in hand, otherwise the craftiest one wins.

sentences.tl: Nel giornalismo, velocità e accuratezza raramente vanno insieme.
sentences.en: In journalism, speed and accuracy rarely go together.

sentences.tl: Vino e formaggio vanno insieme; social media e sonno, molto meno.
sentences.en: Wine and cheese go together; social media and sleep, much less so.

exercises.prompt: La teoria e la pratica devono ______ ______ . (go hand in hand)
Power and responsibility should go hand in hand.
exercises.answer: Potere e responsabilità dovrebbero andare insieme.

expressions.gloss: to play on home turf / have home advantage
expressions.failed_sentence: La nostra squadra stasera gioca in casa, quindi abbiamo ottime possibilità.
expressions.anchor: Home stadium, your crowd, your rules: giocare IN CASA (no article!). Figuratively: any topic where you're strongest. Opposite: giocare in trasferta (away).

sentences.tl: Quando il dibattito si sposta sulla tecnologia, gioco in casa.
sentences.en: When the debate moves to technology, I'm playing on home turf.

sentences.tl: Alla conferenza di Limes sul Mediterraneo, i geopolitici giocano in casa.
sentences.en: At the Limes conference on the Mediterranean, the geopolitics crowd is playing at home.

sentences.tl: La squadra stasera gioca in casa e i biglietti sono esauriti.
sentences.en: The team plays at home tonight and the tickets are sold out.

exercises.prompt: Stasera la squadra gioca ______ ______, quindi abbiamo ottime possibilità. (at home)
exercises.why: fixed: giocare in casa, no article

exercises.prompt: In this negotiation, the lawyers are playing on home turf.
exercises.answer: In questa trattativa, gli avvocati giocano in casa.
exercises.trap: Not «nella casa» — the idiom drops the article.

video_prompts.es2: Interior, modern minimalist apartment, late afternoon golden light. A stylish wool coat lies crumpled in the middle of an otherwise immaculate wooden floor. Slow orbiting camera around the abandoned coat. A woman enters the frame, stops, points at the coat with theatrical exasperation, looking toward someone off-screen. Mood: gentle domestic comedy. Clean composition, shallow depth of field, cinematic. No on-screen text.
video_prompts.pt1: Modern newsroom at night. Inside a glass-walled meeting room, four editors huddle close over a single laptop, whispering, faces lit by the screen glow. Outside the glass, a young journalist stands in the dim open-plan office holding a coffee, watching them, clearly excluded from the secret. Camera slowly pushes in toward the glass wall that separates them. Mood: intrigue, quiet tension. Cinematic, shallow depth of field. No on-screen text.
video_prompts.it3: Evening football stadium, packed home stands roaring with flags and scarves. A confident player in the home kit steps onto the pitch, arms spread wide, soaking in the applause as the chanting grows louder. Camera: low tracking shot behind the player facing the wall of fans, then a slow tilt up the stands. Mood: triumphant, electric. Cinematic sports footage. No on-screen text.

comic_prompts.es3: A crisp 3-panel comic strip in one image, clean European ligne claire style, warm muted colors, panels side by side with thin gutters. Panel 1: a couple sits at a small café table, tense silence; she looks away, he stares into his cup. Panel 2: she stands up, coat over her arm, calm and final, and says in a speech bubble: «La doy por terminada.» Panel 3: he sits alone at the table; a waiter discreetly takes away her untouched cup. The ONLY text in the whole image is the panel-2 speech bubble, EXACTLY: La doy por terminada.
comic_prompts.pt2: A warm 3-panel comic strip in one image, ligne claire style, cozy colors, panels side by side with thin gutters. Panel 1: a Brazilian family dinner table; a teenager slides a smartphone toward the table edge under a napkin. Panel 2: the grandmother, stern but loving, holds up a big glass jar and declares in a speech bubble: «Não tem esse negócio de celular na mesa!» Panel 3: three smartphones sit inside the glass jar on a shelf while the family eats and laughs in the background. The ONLY text in the whole image is the panel-2 speech bubble, EXACTLY: Não tem esse negócio de celular na mesa!
comic_prompts.it1: A noir 3-panel comic strip in one image, dramatic chiaroscuro, deep blues and amber, panels side by side with thin gutters. Panel 1: a detective's desk at night; a massive stack of documents labeled LEGGE under a desk lamp. Panel 2: the detective aims a flashlight across the pages; the beam illuminates some paragraphs while long cone-shaped shadows stretch dramatically behind others. Panel 3: close-up of the detective's face half in shadow, pensive; a rectangular caption box reads: Restano coni d'ombra. The only text in the image: LEGGE on the stack (panel 1) and the caption Restano coni d'ombra. (panel 3).
